info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Card Transaction Switch Routing Decision-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Operational Services Card Transaction Routing Decision API facilitates the effective routing of card transaction requests based on predefined criteria. This API handles the creation of routing decisions that determine how card transactions are processed within the banking operational services framework. It is primarily utilized by developers integrating financial solutions, enabling automated transaction handling and improving operational efficiency. This API ensures that transactions are processed smoothly, enhancing the overall customer experience in banking services.

post.summary: Create a routing decision for card transactions.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new routing decision for card transactions, specifying the parameters that influence the routing logic. Ensure that all necessary information is provided in the request body to successfully process the transaction routing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send routing decision data for card transactions. It contains the necessary information to process the routing decisions effectively.
